card.title: INNISKILLING FUSILIERS
card.text: When you play a card with Intel, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
card.flavorText: The Royal Inniskilling Fusiliers was an Irish regiment of the British Army and was active from 1881 to 1968. During WWII the regiment was raised from 2 battalions to 5, the 1st, 2nd, 5th, 6th and 70th. The 1st Battalion was stationed in British India when the war broke out and fought in the British colony of Burma against the Japanese forces. The 2nd Battalion was part of the British Expeditionary Forces in France before being evacuated at Dunkirk in 1940. In 1942 the battalion was sent to Madagascar where it fought the Vichy French. In 1943 the 2nd participated in the Invasion of Sicily, followed by the advance into Italy, as part of the British Eighth Army. The 5th Battalion served as a home defense formation in the UK where it spent the war. The 6th Battalion was formed in 1940 and was later redesignated 38th (Irish) Infantry Brigade, which fought with the 6th Armoured Division in the Invasion of Sicily, Italy and the Tunisian Campaign. The 70th Battalion was raised early in the war and was for young volunteers who had not reached the age to be conscripted. The 70th was disbanded in 1943 without seeing active service.
